name: live-window-continuity
description: Carry selected non-sensitive context across chat windows with role-aware status footers, a copy-paste handoff card, and verified portable archives.

interface.longDescription: Create clear status footers, no-setup copy-paste handoff cards, and verified plaintext continuity archives for selected non-sensitive context. The plugin preserves user authority, exposes saved cutoffs, and stops on stale, missing, or conflicting state. It does not automatically remember chats or provide hosted storage.
capabilities: Create and verify plaintext continuity archives
defaultPrompt: Add a role-aware footer that shows this chat's current state, gate, and next stop.
Make a short copy-paste handoff card so I can continue this work in a new chat.
Create a verified plaintext archive for this fictional project and report the saved cutoff.
